rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with E2B's cloud sandbox infrastructure to provide secure, isolated code execution environments. Offers tools for creating and managing sandboxes with customizable timeouts and templates, executing Python code using Jupyter Notebook syntax, and running shell commands. Useful for AI applications that need to safely execute user-generated code, perform data analysis, or run system commands without compromising the host environment.
